positions.title: Women’s Basketball Student Manager
positions.description:
• Perform administrative duties, set up equipment, and record player statistics during practice and games.
• Manage practices by keeping the court clean, passing out balls, and assisting the coaching staff as needed.
• Film, edit, and break down live practice recordings using SportsCode to help facilitate the team’s debriefings.
• Oversee time management of drills and scrimmages by tracking game score and shot clock.

positions.description:

positions.description:
